policy: Every registered surface must be explicitly reviewed for every TaskRail version. A review does not imply that the surface's own version must change.

surfaces.name: packaged-skills
surfaces.reason: Agent instructions must match current CLI, deployment, capability, and safety contracts.

surfaces.name: mcp-adapter-and-abilities
surfaces.reason: MCP read abilities and adapter contracts must match the current progressive-disclosure CLI surface.

surfaces.name: framework-version-metadata
surfaces.reason: Package, source and platform installer metadata must identify the same framework release.

surfaces.name: public-api-and-cli-contract
surfaces.reason: Stable public exports and canonical CLI entry points must remain present and deliberate.

surfaces.name: profiles-and-framework-capabilities
surfaces.reason: Built-in profiles and framework capabilities are part of the automation author contract.

surfaces.name: installer-and-release-control
surfaces.reason: Installers, immutable release assets, certification and release controls must still line up.

surfaces.name: performance-regression-contract
surfaces.reason: Performance budgets and baselines must remain present and intentionally calibrated.

surfaces.name: human-and-agent-documentation
surfaces.reason: README, framework guidance and agent instructions must not silently lag release behavior.
